figures.what: Compliance against the number of banned names k = 1..5 for Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-14B with thinking: lexical (L1) compliance and mechanistic compliance under four readings (runtime label coarse and fine, tracer coarse and fine), each with its Wilson 95% band; hand reads substituted shown as k = 5 points with Wilson 95% intervals (diamond committed templates, open square held-out templates).

Every iteration-8 survivor's geodesic distance g to the banned five on each of the four program frames (k 15), grouped by the frozen family map (15 unit-weight Dijkstra, 15 Bellman-Ford/SPFA, 3 BFS variants, 5 other known); circles are classed edge and triangles opposite; the solid line is the frame median of the two non-banned reference classes, the dashed and dotted lines are the frame g of the unit-weight Dijkstra and IDA* programs. Not preregistered.
